mentions.name: Improved SI unit system (planned)
mentions.description: A planned exploration of an improved SI unit system that the author intends to start soon, with example ideas including making the gram (g) rather than the kilogram the base mass unit so that 1 m^3 of water = 1 g, and bringing the comma in as the universal decimal point separator. Work has not started yet and the author solicits new ideas for it.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also looking here sometime soon to playing around with an improved SI unit system. So if anyone has any new ideas here too I'd be very interested.
